title: Two-look OLL and two-look PLL: verified algorithm sheet
notation: R U F L B D are face turns. r and f are wide turns of two layers. M is the slice between L and R, turned the same way as L. An apostrophe means counter-clockwise, 2 means a half turn.
verification: Every algorithm was run on a 54-facelet model of the cube. Three tests: the algorithm returns the solved cube when applied to its own case, its case leaves the first two layers intact, and the case pattern matches the case named for it.
diagram_legend: Each tile is the top face seen from above, ringed by the top row of Back, Right, Front and Left. Yellow means a yellow sticker; grey means any other colour.
